description: The full REST contract under app/api/musafir-cafe/: upload, notes list/create (GET+POST), owner DELETE, and dedup report with auto-hide. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports getPromiseNoteModel, placeNote + constants, isClean, PublicNote/INK_FOR_COLOR). Build EXACTLY per design.md's API contract with MEDIUM fix 1, NIT #7, NIT #8, and the sanitize-copy note baked in.
steps: Create app/api/musafir-cafe/upload/route.ts following app/api/guestbook/upload/route.ts: `export const dynamic='force-dynamic'`, auth required (401 if no session), upload limiter rateLimit('musafir-upload', getClientIp(req), 12, 3600), ALLOWED=['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp'], MAX 5MB, cloudinary.uploader.upload(base64, { folder:'musafir-cafe', resource_type:'image', transformation:[{width:1200,crop:'limit'}] }), return { url: result.secure_url, publicId: result.public_id }. try/catch + console.error + friendly 500.

Create app/api/musafir-cafe/notes/route.ts GET: public, keyset pagination on (created_at,_id). limit default 100 clamp max 200. Parse cursor 'ISO|_id' into {ts,id} in ONE small helper (format+parse together); filter { status:'visible', ...(cursor ? { $or:[{created_at:{$lt:ts}},{created_at:ts,_id:{$lt:id}}] } : {}) }; sort {created_at:-1,_id:-1}; limit+1 probe for hasMore; build nextCursor symmetrically from last non-overflow doc; malformed cursor → first page (never 500). viewer = userKey(await auth()); mine = Boolean(viewer && note.user_id === viewer); build PublicNote EXPLICITLY (never spread the raw doc; NEVER return user_id or *_public_id). Friendly 500 on DB error.

Add POST to app/api/musafir-cafe/notes/route.ts, order of operations fail-cheap-first: auth (401 'Take a seat first. Sign in to leave your note.') → parse body → validate: agree_rules===true (400), content presence (text|drawing_url|photo_url) (400), sanitize+length text ≤280 (400), display_name 2–24 after sanitize (400), is_anonymous→force public display_name to alias/'Anonymous Musafir', alias 2–24 if present, font/color/ink_color in enums (400), INK_FOR_COLOR[color].includes(ink_color) (400 'That ink is hard to read on that paper.'), drawing_url/photo_url if present match ^https://res\.cloudinary\.com/ (400), *_public_id string ≤256, photo_caption sanitize ≤280 → isClean(text) && isClean(photo_caption) AFTER sanitize (400 "Let's keep it kind.") → uid=userKey(session), if(!uid) return 401 → rateLimit('musafir-note-min',uid,1,60) (429) then rateLimit('musafir-note-day',uid,20,86400) (429) → getPromiseNoteModel() → load visible notes with projection 'pos_x pos_y pos_x_v pos_y_v photo_url z_index rotation created_at' (MEDIUM fix 1: rotation and created_at REQUIRED; this ONE projection feeds BOTH placement passes) → z_index=min(maxZ+1,Z_CAP) → _id=new mongoose.Types.ObjectId() → seed from _id → placeNote TWICE (horizontal→pos_x/pos_y with wall {H_WALL_SEED_WIDTH,H_WALL_HEIGHT}; vertical→pos_x_v/pos_y_v with wall {V_WALL_WIDTH,V_WALL_SEED_HEIGHT}; shared rotation) → pick pin_style via seeded PRNG → create with explicit _id + private user_id=uid → return { note: PublicNote } with mine:true (no user_id/public_id).

sanitize-copy note: COPY the identical guestbook sanitize() logic (strip [\u0000-\u001f\u007f], collapse whitespace, trim) inline into the musafir route OR into a tiny lib helper (e.g. lib/musafirValidate.ts) — it is a PRIVATE module-local function in app/api/guestbook/route.ts and CANNOT be imported.
NIT #8: ensure POST only ever accepts/stores Cloudinary drawing_url/photo_url; never blob:/data: preview URLs (the ^https://res\.cloudinary\.com/ regex enforces this).

Create app/api/musafir-cafe/notes/[id]/route.ts DELETE: auth → if(!session?.user) 401 → uid=userKey(session), if(!uid) 401 → load by id, 404 if missing → if(note.user_id !== uid) 403 'You can only take down your own notes.' → hard delete → best-effort cloudinary.uploader.destroy() for each non-null drawing_public_id/photo_public_id (catch+console.error+swallow) → { success:true }.

Create app/api/musafir-cafe/notes/[id]/report/route.ts POST: auth → if(!session?.user) 401 → uid=userKey(session), if(!uid) 401 → MEDIUM fix 1 (report): rateLimit('musafir-report', `${uid}:${id}`, 1, 86400) consulted BEFORE any $inc; if !allowed return { success:true } (no re-increment). NIT #7: drop the redundant findById — const updated = await Model.findOneAndUpdate({_id:id},{ $inc:{report_count:1} },{ new:true }); if(!updated) return 404; if(updated.report_count>=5 && updated.status==='visible'){ updated.status='hidden'; await updated.save() } → { success:true } (never reveal count).
acceptance_criteria: All four route files exist under app/api/musafir-cafe/ with `export const dynamic='force-dynamic'`, NextResponse.json, try/catch+console.error+friendly error, and @/ imports.
GET never returns user_id or *_public_id and includes a boolean `mine`; cursor is a true keyset on (created_at,_id) with malformed-cursor → first page.

POST uses the single projection 'pos_x pos_y pos_x_v pos_y_v photo_url z_index rotation created_at', guards if(!uid) before ratelimit/create, runs placeNote twice (horizontal+vertical, shared rotation), stores private user_id, and returns PublicNote with mine:true.
DELETE is owner-only (uid-guarded) and destroys Cloudinary assets best-effort; report dedups BEFORE the $inc and uses findOneAndUpdate's result as the 404 guard with auto-hide at >=5.
sanitize logic is COPIED (not imported from the guestbook route).
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; both must pass. Routes must import successfully (no DB connection opened at import — PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL may be unset).
